merge_json_files: merge all json files in a directory into a single output file using merge_jsons.py
run_merge_jsons_cli: run the merge_jsons.py script with --json_path and --output_file arguments to combine JSON files
merge_json_with_progress: merge json files with progress tracking that prints status every 1024 files processed
combine_jsonl_files: combine multiple JSONL files from a directory into one merged output file
merge_json_custom_output: merge json files from a specified path and save to a custom output filename
